text:
Sofia: Quick note  we9re opening two small Dedicated G820 pilot racks in Istanbul (IST) and Quito (UIO) today. Aim: edge-friendly latency for EMEA + LATAM. Docs + reservation details below. :earth_africa:
deploy-bot: [deploy] created rack g820-istanbul (rsize=6) and rack g820-quito (rsize=5)  rollout=rl-2026-g820-01
Keegan: Nice. Pilot or GA?
Sofia: Pilot phase: invite-only reserved slots for strategic customers + open burst holds for everyone. Reservation window capped at 72h. If telemetry looks good, we9ll add to reserved catalog next quarter.
finance: Pricing: pilot surcharge = +7% per GPU-hour vs standard Dedicated. Enterprise customers with committed spend can apply for a waiver via billing case. Use PRICING code G820-PILOT.
Keegan: Any changes to preempt policy?
Sofia: Introducing a "soft-replace" policy for these racks: reclaimed holds get a 40m eviction notice webhook and an optional state-sync hook to minimize cold-starts. Auto-fallback routing to nearest compatible pool is enabled.
infra-team: Tagging requirement: please include tags region, project, team (e.g., region=ist project=qa-bot team=search). Untagged holds auto-cancel after 10h. Nightly cleanup job will run to purge stale holds.
eng-oncall: Monitoring rule created: metric rack.g820-*-utilization >= 82% for 10m -> page #eng-oncall and escalate to #infra if error_rate > 3%. We'll also track P95 latency and kv-cache-miss-rate.
sales: Heads-up to commercial: disclose surcharge and soft-replace policy when quoting. Also flag that these are pilot racks with limited capacity.
Sofia: SLA unchanged for Dedicated, but customer docs mark these as "pilot-limited-capacity". Mention in quotes and in onboarding emails.
Keegan: Can we get a short CLI snippet for reservations?
Sofia: CLI snippet for engineers:
```
# list g820 racks in region
redwoodctl racks list --filter "g820" --region ist
# reserve 1 GPU for 48h
redwoodctl reservations create --rack g820-istanbul --count 1 --duration 48h --tags project=my-app,team=search
# show reservation status
redwoodctl reservations describe --id <reservation-id> --format json
```
finance: Reminder to label pilot reservations with sales case ID to help billing reconciliation.
infra-team: Operational safety: enabling a 30m config read-only lock during rollout windows. Dashboard link will be appended to the docs within 2 hours.
eng-oncall: If P95 latency for g820 racks increases > 20% for 3 consecutive intervals, auto-fallback to L-class triggers and infra will be paged.
Sofia: Customer doc: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/g820-pilot (reservation flow, eviction webhook schema, pricing, SLA caveat). Dashboard + telemetry link will be added by EOD. Thanks all  please escalate urgent issues to #eng-oncall.
